name: mens_tops
_doc: Men's tops (long-sleeve golf tops 50002796, the men's section, 2026-11-21): Korean labels -> US sizes. The doc: size_profiles/mens_tops.md; the mechanism: scripts/SIZES.md. The grid is the FALLBACK, used only when the product's own label and chart say nothing.
approved: 2026-11-21, on the owner's section and the women's principle (the Korean label is the body chest in cm; the US size whose chest band holds it); the owner may correct it; 2026-11-22 the review: the bare letters follow the Korean convention (M = 95, so a Korean M is a US S), each band holds its own chest

adidas.evidence: The owner, 2026-11-25: adidas' Asian letters on the men's tops are AS = 95, AM = 100, AL = 105, AXL = 110 (A2XL = 115), the letter winning over the number a listing writes in brackets. The majorgolf charts disagree by model: 13740514016 (KG2154..KG2156, JE8325) '주문사이즈 / AS / AM / AL / AXL / A2XL' over '(95) / (100) / (105) / (110) / (110)', staff fitting 'AM100'; 5176506757 IM7295 S(95) .. 2XL(115), IT7211..IT7213 and IX4323 S(100) .. XL(115); 9998916822 (IS7132) '주문사이즈' S(100) M(105) L(110) XL(115). Only the A-letters (AS, AM ...) take it; a bare S / M / L of adidas keeps the profile's letters.
